grades.question: How is rule determined, including ordinary ties, Eyrie ties, tokens and the Vagabond pawn?

observed.evidence: Special Rules & Edge Cases: ‘most combined warriors and buildings’; ‘Ties mean no one rules.’

grades.reason: Missing Eyrie tie exception, tokens and pawn treatment.

grades.question: What makes a normal move legal, can the same warriors move repeatedly, and do rivers count as paths?
grades.expected_answer: Move more than zero warriors/pawns along one linking path to an adjacent clearing; rule origin or destination or both. Same pieces can move repeatedly. Rivers are not paths unless explicitly treated as such.

observed.answer: A normal move is from a clearing to an adjacent connected clearing, and the mover must rule either the origin or destination. The summary does not say whether the same warriors may move repeatedly or whether rivers count as paths.
observed.evidence: Shared Rules for All Factions—Movement: ‘adjacent connected clearing’ and ‘rule ... the origin or destination.’

grades.reason: Missing positive group, repeat movement and rivers.

grades.question: Describe battle from ambush through removal: foiling, early ending, dice limits, extra hits, removal priorities and who scores removed buildings/tokens.
grades.expected_answer: Defender may ambush matching clearing; attacker may foil with matching ambush. Unfoiled ambush deals two immediate hits; discard defender ambush, end battle if no attacking warriors/pawns remain. Before-roll effects, roll high attacker/low defender, rolled hits capped by own warriors, after-roll effects, count hits including uncapped extra hits and defenseless extra attacker hit if no defending warriors, then deal hits. Each side chooses own removals, warriors first. Whoever removes enemy building/token scores one, including defender.

observed.answer: A defender may play a matching-suit Ambush card at the start of battle to deal 2 hits before dice. The attacker rolls two dice; the higher die gives attacker hits and the lower gives defender hits, with maximum hits limited by warriors present. Remove warriors before tokens/buildings, and the attacker scores 1 VP for each removed building or token. The summary does not describe foiling ambushes, early ending, extra hits, or clarify the warrior limit per side.
observed.evidence: Shared Rules—Battle and Special Rules: ‘Ambush cards ... at the start of battle to deal 2 hits’; ‘Remove warriors first, then tokens/buildings’; each removed building or token scores ‘1 VP for the attacker.’

grades.reason: Incorrectly restricts removal VP to attacker; also missing ambush foil, early end, extra hits and effects.

grades.reason: States crafting card-suit payment instead of crafting icons; remaining costs and constraints unresolved.
